outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes, but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points are overlaid despite N=4, n>100 replicates being reported.
The lower bar graph shows mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (N=4, n>400), but individual data points for the mice/cells are not overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a western blot, not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot of rotarod performance over weeks with mean ± SD error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel E consists of line plots (day1-3 across time points) with mean ± SD; line plots are exempt from the individual data points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line-plot type visualization, which is exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel G shows histological micrographs (Calbindin/DAPI/Merge images), not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.
Both bar graphs in panel H (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD over 9 mice per group) show only bars and error bars without any overlaid individual data points.
